findings.title: Cross-Layer Confused Deputy via Unvalidated fallback_secret_id
findings.description: execute_agent_tool validates ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_PREFIX on primary_id, but overwrites effective_secret_id with fallback_secret_id without re-enforcing ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_PREFIX. [Gemini Note: The system validates `ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_PREFIX` only against the `primary_id`, failing to re-enforce this critical access control on the `effective_secret_id` after it's overwritten by a `fallback_secret_id`, leading to an authorization bypass.]
findings.remediation_hint: Enforce ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_PREFIX validation on fallback_secret_id or remove the fallback_secret_id override.
